test_title: PYST 10: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 13 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming that the information given in the statements given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be different than commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements. 

**Statements:**

1. All spoons are rounds. 

2. All rounds are shapes.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some shapes are rounds. 

II. All spoons are shapes.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b360fcc6168b50c716c3e6a29a30a225af89a99267c82a5830b6bbd8af9c9f0.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some shapes are rounds → True (As All rounds are shapes so, Some shapes are rounds is true)

II. All spoons are shapes → True (As All spoons are rounds and All rounds are shapes so, All spoons are shapes is true)

∴ Here, Both conclusions I and II are true.

&
lt;span style="">Hence, the correct answer is **"Both conclusions I and II follow".**
